subject.title: feat: add Control UI plugin management

question: Should the first Control UI plugin manager include uninstall and a maintained one-click MCP connector catalog, or stay within the canonical issue's catalog, search, install, and enable/disable scope?
rationale: Uninstall was explicitly excluded from the initial issue, while curated connectors add ongoing external endpoint, authentication, support, and security-review ownership that cannot be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Narrow Initial Release
options.body: Ship catalog, search, install, and enable/disable now, moving uninstall and MCP curation to focused follow-up work.

options.title: Keep Expanded Manager
options.body: Accept uninstall and curated MCP connectors after exact-head security and live lifecycle proof.

options.title: Pause For Direction
options.body: Defer the feature until broader plugin marketplace and integration ownership is settled.

recommendation.title: Narrow Initial Release
recommendation.body: Ship catalog, search, install, and enable/disable now, moving uninstall and MCP curation to focused follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical scope, are assigned to the implementation, and have the strongest ownership history across every affected surface.
